title: Vice-President inaugurates the fifth edition of Kashi Tamil Sangamam in Varanasi
subtitle:
Vice-President releases translation of Thirukkural in 50 languages, including 10 foreign languages
Union Education Minister highlights India’s civilisational unity and shared cultural heritage at Kashi Tamil Sangamam 5.0
Shri Pralhad Joshi calls for disseminating the timeless teachings of the Thirukkural
body_text:
Vice-President of India Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan inaugurated the fifth edition of Kashi Tamil Sangamam today in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh in the presence of Union Minister for Education, Shri Pralhad Joshi and Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, Shri Yogi Adityanath. On the occasion, he released editions of the Thirukkural translated into 50 languages, including 10 foreign languages. Addressing the gathering, the Vice-President said that Kashi and Tamil Nadu shared a deep-rooted civilisational, cultural and spiritual relationship that went back thousands of years. This year’s edition was centred on the theme “Thirukkural Abhyas Karen”, meaning “Let us Learn the Thirukkural.”, with the objective of taking the timeless wisdom and ethical values of the Thirukkural , particularly to students and young people. The Vice-President described the Thirukkural as a universal guide to life, with a message of equality, humanism and righteousness that transcended the boundaries of language, region and nation. He urged people to study its teachings and put them into practice in their daily lives. The Vice President noted that the translation of the Thirukkural into 50 languages, including foreign languages, was a significant achievement for Tamil language and literature and a tribute to the universal relevance of Thiruvalluvar’s teachings. He recalled that the first edition of Kashi Tamil Sangamam saw the Thirukkural being published in 13 languages, followed by translations into 16 additional languages in the second edition. He added that its availability in 50 languages in the fifth edition marked an important milestone in taking Tamil literary heritage to a wider audience. The Union Education Minister, in his address, highlighted India’s enduring civilisational and cultural unity, noting that the country’s cultural connections existed since ancient times. He underscored that Kashi Tamil Sangamam embodied the vision of Ek Bharat, Shreshtha Bharat, bringing together the rich cultural, spiritual and intellectual traditions of Tamil Nadu and Kashi. Shri Joshi emphasised the importance of learning and practising the teachings of the Thirukkural , which offered valuable insights into ethical living, good governance, human relationships and moral values. He noted that the initiative was being taken forward across more than 1,330 institutions, enabling students to engage with the timeless wisdom of the Thirukkural and undertake further learning and research.  He welcomed the delegates from Tamil Nadu participating in the fifth edition of Kashi Tamil Sangamam, representing diverse sections of society, including students, teachers, writers, media persons and other professionals. He also highlighted the special focus on women’s participation in this Edition. The Minister appreciated the efforts of IIT Madras, Banaras Hindu University, the Government of Uttar Pradesh and the district administration in facilitating the event and ensuring a meaningful experience for the participating delegates. He called upon the media to help take the message of Kashi Tamil Sangamam to people across the country. Addressing the gathering at Kashi Tamil Sangamam 5.0, Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh Shri Yogi Adityanath highlighted the enduring civilisational and cultural bonds between Kashi and Tamil Nadu, emphasising that India’s unity is rooted in its shared traditions, spiritual heritage and cultural consciousness. He stated that Kashi Tamil Sangamam celebrated the spirit of Ek Bharat, Shreshtha Bharat, in which diverse languages and traditions come together through a shared cultural ethos. Shri Yogi Adityanath underscored the historical and spiritual connections between Tamil Nadu and Kashi, citing traditions associated with Tenkasi, Maharishi Agastya, Adi Shankaracharya, Kumaraguruparar and Subramania Bharati, among others. He highlighted that these historical linkages reflected the deep-rooted cultural exchanges that strengthened India’s civilisational unity across generations. He said that the Sangamam represented the spirit of connecting hearts and strengthening the bonds of national unity through cultural exchange. He reiterated that the vision of Ek Bharat, Shreshtha Bharat was being advanced through initiatives that connected India’s diverse cultural traditions and promoted a shared national identity. Uttar Pradesh Ministers Shri Anil Rajbhar, Shri Ravindra Jaiswal, Shri Dayashankar Mishra and Shri Hansraj Vishwakarma; Secretary, Department of Higher Education, Ms. Deepti Gaur Mukerjee; Chairman of the Bharatiya Bhasha Samiti, Shri Chamu Krishna Shastry; Director of IIT Madras, Shri V. Kamakoti; Vice-Chancellor of Banaras Hindu University, Prof. Ajit Kumar Chaturvedi; spiritual leaders, scholars, delegates from Tamil Nadu, students and members of the public attended the event. The fifth edition of Kashi Tamil Sangamam (KTS) is being held from 28 November to 12 December 2026. It is being organised by the Ministry of Education, in collaboration with IIT Madras, Banaras Hindu University (BHU), the Central Institute of Classical Tamil, Chennai, the Government of Uttar Pradesh, and various Ministries and departments of the Government of India. #Watch #LIVE: Inauguration of Kashi Tamil Sangamam 5.0 from Namo Ghat, Varanasi. #KashiTamilSangamam5  https://t.co/5gpqNfRmUJ — Ministry of Education (@EduMinOfIndia) November 28, 2026 From the sacred Ganga of Kashi to the timeless wisdom of the Thirukkural, the bonds between Kashi and Tamil Nadu reflect the civilisational unity of Bharat.

Addressed the inaugural ceremony of #KashiTamilSangamam 5.0 in the august presence of Hon’ble Vice President Shri @VPIndia C.P. Radhakrishnan ji and Hon’ble Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh Shri @myogiadityanath ji, along with eminent scholars, academicians and delegates.

Inspired by Hon’ble Prime Minister Shri @narendramodi Ji’s vision of #EkBharatShreshthaBharat, this edition, themed 'Thirukkural Payilvom – Thirukkural Abhyas Karen', brings together nearly 1,400 delegates from Tamil Nadu and students from 1,380 Higher Education Institutions. With its 1,330 couplets on ethics, governance and human values, Thirukkural's timeless wisdom is being taken to wider audiences through books in 50 languages. These efforts, alongside student engagement initiatives, advance the vision of #NEP2020 by bringing India's rich knowledge traditions and linguistic heritage into mainstream education.

KTS 5.0 thus strengthens the connection between India's civilisational heritage and the aspirations of a culturally rooted, knowledge-driven #ViksitBharat. — Pralhad Joshi (@JoshiPralhad) November 28, 2026 काशी की पवित्र गंगा से लेकर तिरुक्कुरल की समृद्ध साहित्यिक परंपरा तक, काशी और तमिलनाडु के बीच का संबंध भारत की साझा सभ्यता, संस्कृति और ज्ञान-विरासत का प्रतीक रहा है।

आज #KashiTamilSangamam 5.0 के उद्घाटन समारोह को संबोधित किया। इस अवसर पर भारत के माननीय उपराष्ट्रपति श्री सी. पी. राधाकृष्णन जी और उत्तर प्रदेश के मुख्यमंत्री श्री @myogiadityanath जी की गरिमामयी उपस्थिति रही। समारोह में अनेक विद्वान, शिक्षाविद् और प्रतिनिधि भी सम्मिलित हुए।

माननीय प्रधानमंत्री श्री @narendramodi जी की #EkBharatShreshthaBharat की परिकल्पना को आगे बढ़ाते हुए, इस संस्करण की थीम 'तिरुक्कुरल पयिल्वोम – तिरुक्कुरल अभ्यास करें' रखी गई है। इस आयोजन में तमिलनाडु से लगभग 1,400 प्रतिनिधि और देशभर के 1,380 उच्च शिक्षण संस्थानों के विद्यार्थी सहभागिता कर रहे हैं। तिरुक्कुरल के 1,330 दोहों में समाहित नैतिकता, सुशासन और मानवीय मूल्यों की शिक्षाएँ आज भी उतनी ही प्रासंगिक हैं। इन अमूल्य विचारों को 50 भाषाओं में पुस्तकों के माध्यम से जन-जन तक पहुँचाने की पहल इस ज्ञान-परंपरा को और व्यापक बनाएगी। साथ ही, विद्यार्थियों की सहभागिता के माध्यम से उन्हें भारत की समृद्ध ज्ञान-विरासत से जोड़ने का प्रयास #NEP2020 की भावना को साकार करता है।

#KTS 5.0 हमारी गौरवशाली सभ्यतागत विरासत को नई पीढ़ी से जोड़ते हुए सांस्कृतिक चेतना और ज्ञान-आधारित #ViksitBharat के संकल्प को और सशक्त कर रहा है।

ಕಾಶಿಯ ಪವಿತ್ರ ಗಂಗೆಯಿಂದ ತಿರುಕ್ಕುರಳ್‌ನ ಕಾಲಾತೀತ ಜ್ಞಾನದವರೆಗೆ, ಕಾಶಿ ಮತ್ತು ತಮಿಳುನಾಡಿನ ನಡುವಿನ ಬಾಂಧವ್ಯವು ಭಾರತದ ನಾಗರಿಕತೆಯ ಏಕತೆಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿಬಿಂಬಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

ಗೌರವಾನ್ವಿತ ಉಪರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಪತಿ ಶ್ರೀ @VPIndia ಸಿ.ಪಿ. ರಾಧಾಕೃಷ್ಣನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಉತ್ತರ ಪ್ರದೇಶದ  ಮುಖ್ಯಮಂತ್ರಿ ಶ್ರೀ @myogiadityanath ಅವರ ಘನ ಉಪಸ್ಥಿತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ, ಖ್ಯಾತ ವಿದ್ವಾಂಸರು, ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ತಜ್ಞರು ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರತಿನಿಧಿಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ #KashiTamilSangamam 5.0 ಉದ್ಘಾಟನಾ ಸಮಾರಂಭವನ್ನು ಉದ್ದೇಶಿಸಿ ಮಾತನಾಡಿದೆನು.

ಗೌರವಾನ್ವಿತ ಪ್ರಧಾನಮಂತ್ರಿ ಶ್ರೀ @narendramodi ಅವರ #EkBharatShreshthaBharat ದೂರದೃಷ್ಟಿಯಿಂದ ಪ್ರೇರಿತವಾದ ಈ ಸಂಗಮವು ' ತಿರುಕ್ಕುರಳ್ ಪಯಿಲ್ವೋಮ್ – ತಿರುಕ್ಕುರಳ್ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ್ ಕರೇನ್ (ತಿರುಕ್ಕುರಳ್ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾಡೋಣ) ಎಂಬ ಧ್ಯೇಯದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಆಯೋಜಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. 
ಈ ಸಂಗಮವು ತಮಿಳುನಾಡಿನ ಸುಮಾರು 1,400 ಪ್ರತಿನಿಧಿಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ 1,380 ಉನ್ನತ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳನ್ನು ಒಗ್ಗೂಡಿಸಿದೆ. ನೀತಿಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ, ಆಡಳಿತ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾನವೀಯ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳ ಕುರಿತಾದ 1,330 ದ್ವಿಪದಿಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿರುವ ತಿರುಕ್ಕುರಳ್‌ನ ಕಾಲಾತೀತ ಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು 50 ಭಾಷೆಗಳ ಪುಸ್ತಕಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಓದುಗರಿಗೆ ತಲುಪಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತಿದೆ. ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳ ಪಾಲ್ಗೊಳ್ಳುವಿಕೆಯ ಉಪಕ್ರಮಗಳ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಈ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಗಳು, ಭಾರತದ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಪರಂಪರೆ ಮತ್ತು ಭಾಷಾ ವೈವಿಧ್ಯತೆಯನ್ನು ಮುಖ್ಯವಾಹಿನಿಯ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೆ ತರುವ ಮೂಲಕ #NEP2020 ರ ಆಶಯವನ್ನು ಬಲಪಡಿಸುತ್ತಿದೆ.

ಹೀಗೆ #KashiTamilSangamam 5.0  ಭಾರತದ ನಾಗರಿಕತೆಯ ಪರಂಪರೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕವಾಗಿ ಬೇರೂರಿರುವ, ಜ್ಞಾನಾಧಾರಿತ #ViksitBharat ಆಶಯಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಬಾಂಧವ್ಯವನ್ನು ಮತ್ತಷ್ಟು ಬಲಪಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
@VPIndia — Pralhad Joshi (@JoshiPralhad) November 28, 2026 युवाओं का उत्साह, जिज्ञासा और नए विचार ही भारत की सबसे बड़ी शक्ति हैं!

काशी तमिल संगमम 5.0 के दौरान तमिलनाडु से आए विद्यार्थियों के साथ संवाद करना एक बेहद सुखद और समृद्ध अनुभव रहा। उनकी बातचीत, हँसी और सीखने के साझा पलों में उनकी जिज्ञासा, नए विचारों और उत्साह की झलक देखने को मिली।

इन युवा प्रतिभाओं का उत्साह और सीखने की ललक इस विश्वास को और मजबूत करती है कि भारत की समृद्ध सभ्यतागत विरासत को नई सोच और नए दृष्टिकोण के साथ आगे बढ़ाने में युवा पीढ़ी की महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका है।

ನಮ್ಮ ಯುವಶಕ್ತಿ ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ನಮಗೆ ಸ್ಫೂರ್ತಿ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ!

ಕಾಶಿ ತಮಿಳು ಸಂಗಮಂ 5.0 ನಲ್ಲಿ ತಮಿಳುನಾಡಿನ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಮಾತನಾಡಿದ್ದು ತುಂಬಾ ಖುಷಿ ಮತ್ತು ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಅನುಭವ ನೀಡಿತು. ಅವರ ಮಾತು, ನಗು ಮತ್ತು ಕಲಿಕೆಯ ಕ್ಷಣಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅವರ ಕುತೂಹಲ, ಹೊಸ ಆಲೋಚನೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಉತ್ಸಾಹ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು. ಭಾರತದ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಂಪರೆಯು ಇಂದಿನ ಯುವಜನರ ಮೂಲಕ ಹೊಸ ರೂಪ ಪಡೆದು ಮುಂದುವರಿಯುತ್ತಿದೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಈ ಯುವ ಮನಸ್ಸುಗಳ ಉತ್ಸಾಹ ಮತ್ತೊಮ್ಮೆ ಸಾಬೀತುಪಡಿಸಿದೆ.

Our Yuva Shakti never fails to inspire!

Interacting with students from Tamil Nadu at Kashi Tamil Sangamam 5.0 was a truly enriching experience. Their conversations, laughter and shared moments of learning brought out their curiosity, fresh perspectives and enthusiasm. The enthusiasm and curiosity of these young minds reaffirmed that India's rich civilisational legacy continues to find new meaning and expression through its youth.
